compatibility_invariants.rule: Source Snapshot bytes and source_hash remain exact and product-owned.
Both terminal outcomes use model.request.completed with terminal.status settled or cancelled.
Shared identity includes producer, optional tenant, org, project, event type and exact Source request ID.
Source, shared Envelope and X M0 hashes remain independent and separately pinned.
The two Source seeds preserve the existing ten M0 event IDs/hashes, ten local refs/idempotency values, eight Gap rows, two provenance IDs and read-model expectations.
Cursor, high-watermark, page/retry/ingestion state never enters Event or item-linked provenance identity.
The current completed-execution endpoint, page DTO, credential purpose, activation-forward bootstrap and at-least-once checkpoint behavior remain the Reference Connector compatibility path.

known_product_local_differences.rule: The shared parent projects to one X terminal event plus four X Gap events; this is a target-local projection and does not add four shared top-level events.
Current X M0 event IDs and DB Gap/provenance IDs use different historical deterministic UUID variant rules and remain independently pinned.
Current X investigation APIs expose Evidence/Gap/provenance, not the complete shared Connector lifecycle projection.

non_goals: No product-local IAM, registry, billing, persistence, analysis or UI replacement.
No runtime deployment, feed replay, cursor mutation or new live traffic.
